blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-08-08. At Ethereum block 25712273, canonical FPI 0x5ca135cb8527d76e932f34b5145575f9d8cbe08e remained a direct, immutable token whose verified transfer and minter paths contain no blacklist, freeze, pause, seize, allowlist, or arbitrary-holder burn. At Fraxtal block 39703046, proxy 0xfc00000000000000000000000000000000000003 used implementation 0xfcc0d30000000000000000000000000000000003 and ProxyAdmin 0xfc0000000000000000000000000000000000000a; current implementation selector and source review likewise found no active holder restriction. The verified ZKsync CrossChainCanonicalV2 deployment has the same restriction-free transfer model. Frax's FPI documentation describes protocol mint/redemption and does not establish a separate issuer legal account-freeze power. Current blacklistability is therefore false; the Fraxtal 3/5 Safe's immediate ability to introduce restrictions by upgrading code is represented separately as a restrictable deployment in the transfer overlay.

oracleRisk.summary: FPI's redemption target uses a specialized Chainlink oracle that commits the monthly CPI-U rate, but FPI is minted and redeemed through the FRAX-backed Controller Pool and stabilized through AMOs rather than borrower positions subject to collateral-price liquidation.

branchApplicability.rationale: Frax documents FPI as a 100%-collateral-ratio protocol balance sheet: users mint or redeem FPI for Legacy Frax Dollar through the Controller Pool, AMOs deploy the collateral, and FPIS sales replenish backing when yield trails CPI. It does not document borrower-specific debt positions, collateral health ratios, or oracle-triggered collateral liquidations, so liquidation branches are not applicable.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: FPI is deployed on Ethereum, Fraxtal, and zkSync Era. Frax documentation describes the Fraxtal bridge as derived from Optimism's standard bridge for Ethereum/Fraxtal asset movement, and Pharos treats the Ethereum/Fraxtal rows as canonical rollup-bridge exposure. 2026-07-30 cohort T11 pass: the previously unmatched zkSync Era supply row is now matched to the verified issuer-canonical CrossChainCanonicalV2 deployment 0xd405617db7473b0a3158356be7bc9ebec6d88b85 (sole-minter deployer EOA 0x6549DAa31C76d5C19099B7bdAD82d8813774C651, the same Frax zkSync deployer pattern as the reviewed FRAX zkSync route), leaving no unmatched material deployment.
